headline: AVINO SILVER & GOLD POSTS RECORD Q1 — Revenue Surges 109% to $39.4M as Silver Averages $86.42/oz
snippet: Avino Silver & Gold Mines (TSX: ASM) posted record Q1 2026 revenues of $39.4M — up 109% year-over-year — with net income of $15.9M and EBITDA of $25.5M as silver averaged $86.42/oz; 60% of revenues were silver, validating the leverage thesis for smaller silver producers whose margins are the most sensitive to spot price moves.

headline: TRUMP-XI MEETING FOCUSES ON RARE EARTHS AND AI — China's 90% Refining Grip Is the Real Agenda in Beijing
snippet: Foreign Policy's May 13 analysis of the Beijing summit finds that China's control of 90% of global rare earth refining — and export controls on 16 elements — has moved the center of gravity away from tariffs and toward structural supply chain dominance; what Xi offers on gallium, germanium, and magnet precursors may determine whether rare earth miners outside China see sustained demand.

headline: US-CHINA RARE EARTH DEAL HOLDS as Beijing Summit Begins — China Seen Easing Gallium, Germanium Curbs for H200 Chips
snippet: A senior US official confirmed the October 2025 rare earths deal with China remains in force as the Trump-Xi summit opens; analysts expect China to partially lift export controls on gallium, germanium, antimony, and graphite in exchange for a framework on H200 chip access — a deal that would directly benefit downstream processors and EV battery supply chains.

headline: FIRST MAJESTIC SILVER Q1: Record $476.7M Revenue Up 95%, Dividend Nearly Quadrupled on Surging Silver Price
snippet: First Majestic Silver (TSX: AG) posted record Q1 2026 revenues of $476.7M — up 95% from Q1 2025 — with net earnings of $128.1M, free cash flow of $223.5M, and its largest-ever quarterly dividend (roughly 4x last year's level); 66% of revenue came from silver, confirming the operational leverage that major silver miners carry at current spot prices.

headline: Why Silver's 6% Pre-Summit Rally Is Really an AI STORY — Industrial Demand Is the Structural Driver
snippet: GoldSilver.com argues the dominant driver of silver's 6%+ surge is not China trade relief but AI infrastructure build-out: approximately 60% of annual silver demand is industrial — solar, EVs, semiconductors — and the AI construction supercycle is pulling those supply chains simultaneously; the Trump-Xi trade truce provides a backdrop, but the structural demand signal is already baked into the chart.

headline: FARADAY COPPER Hits 36m at 0.81% Cu Near-Surface at Copper Creek — Heap-Leach Oxide Resource Expansion in Play
snippet: Faraday Copper (TSX: FDY) reported Phase IV drill results at Copper Creek in Arizona — part of the Lundin Group — including 36.0m at 0.81% Cu (0.68% acid soluble) from surface at Copper Giant and 347m at 0.26% Cu at Marsha; 13 of 19 holes hit mineralization within 40m of surface, supporting a potential heap-leachable oxide resource update at a time when copper sits near all-time highs.

headline: ROXMORE GOLD Drills 138m at 0.65 g/t Au and 110m at 1.31 g/t at Converse — System Now Extends 400m Below PEA Pit
snippet: Roxmore Resources (TSX: RM) extended its Converse Gold-Silver deposit in Nevada's Battle Mountain-Eureka Trend to more than 400m below the open pit outlined in its recent PEA, with drill intercepts of 138.1m at 0.65 g/t Au and 3.5 g/t Ag from 57m, and 110.9m at 1.31 g/t Au from 460m depth — a result suggesting significant resource growth potential in a well-established Nevada gold corridor.
